6×6 판에 X와 O가 번갈아 돌을 하나씩 놓는다. 돌을 놓은 자리에서: On a 6×6 board, X and O take turns placing one disc at a time. Looking in each of the eight horizontal, vertical, and diagonal directions from the square where the disc was placed, if one or more of the opponent's discs continue without a gap and the player's own disc comes right after them, all of the opponent's discs in between are flipped to become the player's own discs. A player may play only on a square where one or more of the opponent's discs can be flipped. If there is no square to play on, the turn is passed. When there are no more places to play, the side with more discs wins.

On a 6×6 board, X and O take turns placing one disc at a time. Looking only in each of the four horizontal and vertical directions from the square where the disc was placed, if one or more of the opponent's discs continue without a gap and the player's own disc comes right after them, all of the opponent's discs in between are flipped to become the player's own discs. No discs are flipped in the diagonal directions. A player may play only on a square where one or more of the opponent's discs can be flipped. If there is no square to play on, the turn is passed. When there are no more places to play, the side with more discs wins.
판은 행 A~F(A가 맨 위), 열 1~6으로 적고 빈칸은 \".\"이다: The board is written with rows A to F (A at the top) and columns 1 to 6, and an empty square is ".". A coordinate is written by joining the row and the column, as in "B2".
X 차례다. X가 A1에 두면 뒤집히는 O 돌은 몇 개인가?: It is X's turn. If X plays at A1, how many O discs are flipped?
X 차례다. 다음 중 X가 둘 수 없는 자리는?: It is X's turn. Which of the following is a square where X cannot play?
X 차례다. X가 C2에 두면 뒤집히는 O 돌은 몇 개인가?: It is X's turn. If X plays at C2, how many O discs are flipped?
X 차례다. 이번 수로 O 돌을 가장 많이 뒤집는 자리는?: It is X's turn. Which square flips the most O discs with this move?
